title: Docres
summary: Raleigh names Docres in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Docres, whom the Lacedaemonians imployed in Pausanias his stead after he was called backe from Bizantium. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter VII, §. II, sig. 420b–421a
